about: Which agents ~/.agentbar/wire-disabled switches off. `file` is the file's exact text
(null: no file); `ids` is what it reads as, sorted. Read through the file by
`#` starts a comment, surrounding blanks are trimmed, ids are lowercased, a line that
is not ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$ is skipped, an unknown id is kept. `$FEFF` in a file is a raw U+FEFF (see rule-matching).
